user.title: Connect to Ovumcy
user.description: Enter the URL of your Ovumcy instance and an API key. Create the key in Ovumcy under Settings → API key — a read-only key is enough — and paste it here; it is shown only once.

data.ip_override: IP override (optional) — pin the base URL's hostname to this IP if DNS can't resolve it (e.g. 10.5.1.57). HTTPS, the Host header, and cert checks still use the hostname above; only the network connection itself uses this IP.

reauth_confirm.title: Ovumcy needs a new API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {base_url} was revoked, replaced or is missing. Generate a new key in Ovumcy under Settings → API key and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Ovumcy rejected this API key. It may have been revoked or replaced.
error.invalid_key_format: That does not look like an Ovumcy API key — it should start with ovk_.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Ovumcy instance.

abort.already_configured: This Ovumcy account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key was accepted.
